name: Allison Oh
title: Design and Media Student
bio: Hi, I'm Allison, an undergraduate at NYU's Tandon School of Engineering studying Integrated Design and Media, minoring in psychoanalysis. I’m fascinated by the intersection of psychology, human-centered design, and artificial intelligence. My goal is to utilize human-centered design principles to inform the development of AI products, ensuring they are easy to use and beneficial for humanity. I’m passionate about the research aspect of UX, delving into user behaviors, pain points, and motivations to inform the development of AI products.
